n = int(input())
b = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
diff = [0] * n
index = 0

even = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
odd = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 1 else 0

for i in range(1, n):
    if even == odd:
        diff[index] = abs(a[i] - a[i - 1])
        index += 1
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        even += 1
    else:
        odd += 1

diff = sorted(diff[:index])
sum_ = 0
count = 0
for i in range(index):
    if diff[i] + sum_ <= b:
        count += 1
        sum_ += diff[i]
print(count)
</translated_code>
